This file contains the summary metrics reported in the paper in one place.
```{r, echo = FALSE}
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)
library(scoringutils)
library(tidyr)

# delays
tar_read(clean_weekly_data)

# scores
tar_read(scores_su)
tar_read(scores_su_ag)

# training volume allocation
tar_read(map_tv)
```
